pr_title: [api-minor] Use the `NodeCanvasFactory`/`NodeCMapReaderFactory` classes as defaults in Node.js environments (issue 11900)
pr_body:
This moves, and slightly simplifies, code that's currently residing in the unit-test utils into the actual library, such that it's bundled with `GENERIC`-builds and used in e.g. the API-code.

As an added bonus, this also brings out-of-the-box support for CMaps in e.g. the Node.js examples.

Fixes #11900

*Edit:* Slightly smaller diff with https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/pull/12039/files?w=1

issue_context.title: pdf2png example cannot render Japanese font
issue_context.body:
Configuration:
- Web browser and its version:
N/A? Just using pdf.js (8b9492a5c41d0776488a27021981b60fbf23a3bf) by node

- Operating system and its version:
macOS 10.15.3

- PDF.js version:
8b9492a5c41d0776488a27021981b60fbf23a3bf

- Is a browser extension:
N/A

Steps to reproduce the problem:
1. `curl -o issue.pdf https://www.soumu.go.jp/johotsusintokei/whitepaper/ja/h25/pdf/n4100000.pdf`
2. apply the following diff:

```diff
--- a/examples/node/pdf2png/pdf2png.js
+++ b/examples/node/pdf2png/pdf2png.js
@@ -51,7 +51,7 @@ NodeCanvasFactory.prototype = {
 var pdfjsLib = require("pdfjs-dist/es5/build/pdf.js");

 // Relative path of the PDF file.
-var pdfURL = "../../../web/compressed.tracemonkey-pldi-09.pdf";
+var pdfURL = "issue.pdf";

 // Read the PDF file into a typed array so PDF.js can load it.
 var rawData = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(pdfURL));
```

3. run `node pdf2png.js`

What is the expected behavior? (add screenshot)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1422834/81829767-38cf2300-9576-11ea-896f-78f95e29ed77.png)

What went wrong? (add screenshot)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1422834/81829813-45ec1200-9576-11ea-8e91-f1d48c15a5fb.png)

Link to a viewer (if hosted on a site other than mozilla.github.io/pdf.js or as Firefox/Chrome extension):
This document is published by the Government of Japan: https://www.soumu.go.jp/johotsusintokei/whitepaper/ja/h25/pdf/n4100000.pdf
comments:
Hi @moznion 

In order to support non-latin characters you have to include cMaps
These are located in node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps

Because you are using node you have to make sure to import NodeCMapReaderFactory, the default CMap reader factory will not work in node.js

```javascript
const { NodeCMapReaderFactory } = require('pdfjs-dist/lib/test/unit/test_utils');
```

then add NodeCMapReaderFactory and the cmap location to your getDocument call:

```javascript
PDFJSLib.getDocument({
  data: rawData,
  cMapUrl: 'node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps/',
  cMapPacked: true,
  CMapReaderFactory: NodeCMapReaderFactory
}).promise;
```

This should solve your problem. Now you should see the japanese characters!

review_comments:
I'm *really* not happy about the discrepancy between `CMapReaderFactory` (on `getDocument`) and `canvasFactory`, since in the first case the user needs to pass a class and in the second one a class *instance*.
I've tried to make this at least *slightly* clearer by updating the JSDoc comment here, but it still doesn't seem great. Unfortunately it might simply be (years) too late to try and "fix" this, and furthermore I'm also not entirely sure how to improve it (given how `canvasFactory` is being used). Oh, well...

Maybe we should also export the various canvas/CMap-factories in the API as well, such that we could remove things like e.g. https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/9993397e30bdd6c3e63800753da3e4c971fa2f35/examples/node/pdf2png/pdf2png.js#L20-L49
However, I'm not sure if that's (generally) desirable and it also felt somewhat orthogonal to the rest of the patch...
